sloka: स रराज रथे तस्मिन् राजसूनुर्महाबलः।वृतो नैर्ऋतशार्दूलैर्वज्रपाणिरिवामरैः ।। ६.६९.२८ ।।
transliteration: sa rarāja rathe tasmin rājasūnurmahābalaḥ।vṛto nairṛtaśārdūlairvajrapāṇirivāmaraiḥ ।। 6.69.28 ।।

translations.english: The tiger among ogres (Atikaya) surrounded by the great army of ogres, the prince was shining in the chariot like Indra, the king of gods and wielder of thunderbolt.
